meta.title: Strickle
meta.description: Your pay agent: irregular income, a regular salary.

rules.title: Rules of your boxes
rules.intro: These rules live in your vault, so the agent cannot change them. Making a rule stricter applies now. Making it looser waits at least a day, and you apply it yourself afterwards. That includes a lock date: it can be shortened after the wait, so it protects you from a hasty decision, not from yourself.
rules.looser: Looser: waits {hours} h. After that you apply it yourself.

view.title: Account view
view.publicBanner: Everything on this page is public on the Arc network. Anyone with this address can see it. The agent's plan and private notes are not shown.
view.noPayments: No payments have arrived in this account yet.
view.historyUnavailable: The payment history is not available right now. The balances above are read straight from the network.
view.error: This account could not be read. Try again in a moment.
view.notFound: This address is not a Strickle account.
view.shareIntro: Your accountant can read your boxes, their rules and the agent's payments with this link. It shows what is already public on the Arc network. It does not show your plan, and the link does not hide anything: anyone who has your account address can see the same data. It cannot be revoked.
view.keysIntro: Private notes can be shared with an accountant through a view key that only they hold. That is not active for ordinary accounts yet.
view.copyFailed: Select the link and copy it.

accountant.title: Accountant view key
accountant.intro: A view key lets you read the notes a client's private account has sealed for accountants. The key stays in this browser, and so does its backup unless you download it. Create one key per client.
accountant.badKey: That is not a valid key.
accountant.publicKey: Give this key to the person whose notes you review
accountant.empty: No private notes have been shared with this key yet.
accountant.unavailable: The notes could not be loaded right now. Try again in a moment.
accountant.limits: You see the amount, asset, box and lock of each note at the moment it was created. You do not see who owns it, who it was paid to or whether it has been spent. The short identifier of your key is public on the network, so anyone can tell which notes were sealed for the same key. Use one key per client.

currency.title: Currency of each box
currency.explain: When you choose euros, the agent converts the dollars in that box into euros within the limits of your vault: it never accepts more than 1.5% below the market reference, never more than {cap} a day, and it shows each conversion in Activity.
